name: yatt
title: Yet Another Timezone Tool
description: Scrub a whole day across your cities, and type any time you say out loud to see it everywhere.
author: black

commands.name: convert
commands.title: Convert Time
commands.description: Type a time, a window or a date with a place (15-17 sf, tomorrow 9 utc) and see it in every location. Empty shows the current time.

preferences.name: defaultAnchor
preferences.title: Default Anchor Zone
preferences.description: The zone a typed time is in when you name no place.

preferences.name: popToRootAfterCopy
preferences.title: After Copying
preferences.description: Go back to the root search after copying, whatever the launcher's own Pop to Root setting says.
preferences.label: Return to root search

preferences.name: dateOrder
preferences.title: Numeric Date Order
preferences.description: How to read a date typed as 3/9. Dates like 2026-09-03 always work.

commands.name: in-the-time-zone
commands.title: In the Timezone
commands.description: Scrub a whole day across your locations, with working hours, sunrise and sunset for each.

preferences.name: defaultScrubMinutes
preferences.title: Arrow Key Scrub Minutes
preferences.description: Arrow keys (left, right) scrub time by this many minutes.

preferences.name: optionScrubMinutes
preferences.title: Option+Arrow Key Scrub Minutes
preferences.description: Option with the arrow keys scrubs time by this many minutes.

commands.name: manage-locations
commands.title: Manage Locations
commands.description: Add, remove, order and alias the cities and time zones that Convert Time and In the Timezone show.

preferences.name: onlineLookup
preferences.title: Online Lookup
preferences.description: Search OpenStreetMap when a place is not in the built-in list.
preferences.label: Search OpenStreetMap for unknown places

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time Format
preferences.description: How times are shown and copied. You can type either form: 15:00 or 3pm.

preferences.name: copyTemplate
preferences.title: Copy Template
preferences.description: Format of one location in copied text. Placeholders: {time} {label} {code} {abbr} {date} {day} {offset} {tz} {dot}. {dot} is 🟢 🟡 🔴 for business, shoulder and off hours. {abbr} is left out when it repeats {code}, and empty brackets are removed: UTC copies as '11:15 UTC', not '11:15 UTC (UTC)'.

preferences.name: copySeparator
preferences.title: Copy Separator
preferences.description: Text between locations when copying all rows as one line.

preferences.name: showLocalRow
preferences.title: Local Row
preferences.description: Show a Local row when none of your locations is in this machine's zone.
preferences.label: Always show local time

preferences.name: sortOrder
preferences.title: Sort Locations
preferences.description: Order of rows in Convert Time and In the Timezone. Manual keeps the arrangement from Manage Locations.

preferences.name: businessHours
preferences.title: Business Hours
preferences.description: Hours shown green, as start-end in 24-hour time, e.g. 9-18. Each location can override this.

preferences.name: shoulderHours
preferences.title: Shoulder Hours
preferences.description: Hours shown yellow around the business day, as start-end, e.g. 7-21. Other hours are red.

preferences.name: colorBusiness
preferences.title: Business Hours Colour
preferences.description: Hex colour for the business-hours dot in Convert Time, e.g. #34C759. Empty uses Raycast's green. When set, the time text shows in the plain text colour.

preferences.name: colorShoulder
preferences.title: Shoulder Hours Colour
preferences.description: Hex colour for the shoulder-hours dot in Convert Time, e.g. #FFCC00. Empty uses Raycast's yellow. When set, the time text shows in the plain text colour.

preferences.name: colorOff
preferences.title: Off Hours Colour
preferences.description: Hex colour for the off-hours dot in Convert Time, e.g. #FF3B30. Empty uses Raycast's red. When set, the time text shows in the plain text colour.

preferences.name: stripColorBusiness
preferences.title: Hours Colour: Business
preferences.description: Hex colour for business-hours cells in the hour strip and the timeline. Empty uses their own green.

preferences.name: stripColorShoulder
preferences.title: Hours Colour: Shoulder
preferences.description: Hex colour for shoulder-hours cells in the hour strip and the timeline. Empty uses their own ochre.

preferences.name: stripColorOff
preferences.title: Hours Colour: Off
preferences.description: Hex colour for off-hours cells in the hour strip and the timeline. Empty uses a quiet grey, so the picture is calmer than the dots; set it to your off-hours colour to match.

preferences.name: locationsFile
preferences.title: Locations File
preferences.description: Optional. A JSON file that holds your location list, for example in a synced directory, so two machines share it. Leave empty to store the list in Vicinae on this machine. Use a full path or one starting with ~.
